about_the_game:
Mythbeasts - An Epic Creature Collection Adventure

Features & Gameplay

Embark on an endless adventure in a vast world filled with mystery and wonder:

  • Befriend 200+ Unique Mythbeasts - Discover and bond with an incredible variety of creatures, each with their own personalities, abilities, and evolutionary paths

  • Endless Exploration - Journey through diverse regions, with new areas continuously added post-launch to keep your adventure fresh and exciting

  • Progressive Challenge System - Battle trainers to unlock new regions and discover rare mythbeasts, with difficulty scaling naturally as you progress

  • Evolution Mechanics - Watch your mythbeasts grow and evolve as they reach new levels, unlocking powerful new forms and abilities

  • Unlimited Progression - No level caps mean your mythbeasts can grow as strong as you want as long as you grind for it

Combat System

Experience strategic turn-based battles with depth and tactical complexity:

  • Speed-Based Initiative - Faster mythbeasts act first, and exceptional speed differences can grant multiple actions before the other can attack

  • Diverse Movesets - Every mythbeast commands 4-6 unique moves, giving you countless strategic combinations

  • Complex Type System - With 1-3 typings per creature, discover powerful advantages and critical weaknesses

  • Unique Abilities - Each mythbeast possesses special abilities that can turn the tide of battle - find the perfect partner for your playstyle

  • Advanced Move Effects - Master moves with stat modifications, recoil damage, healing effects, and status conditions for truly strategic gameplay

Overworld Exploration

Navigate a world that rewards both clever thinking and raw power

The overworld presents a maze making you wonder about where to venture next, but strong mythbeasts can forge new paths through seemingly impossible obstacles. Choose your route: solve the intended maze or power through with sheer determination and well-trained companions.

About the Developer

Hi! I'm an autistic solo developer who has taken on the massive challenge of creating Mythbeasts entirely on my own. I handle:

  • All programming and coding in Unity

  • Game balancing and combat mechanics

  • World building and level design

  • Trainer placement and mythbeast distribution

  • Bug fixes and optimization

  • Story development and lore creation

My autism gives me an incredible attention to detail and the ability to hyperfocus on perfecting every system in the game. However, while I excel at the technical aspects, I need professional artists to help bring my vision to life with the beautiful art, animations, and music this project deserves. So when any funds open up i can upgrade all the art and add animations. Plus since i've been little i've been playing monster collector games non-stop.

Join me in bringing the world of Mythbeasts to life. Together, we can create something truly magical.
